critic.fix_suggestion: For the wing engine primitives, apply a translation along the local X-axis (outward from fuselage) to increase the distance between the engine center and the wing root by 40%. Simultaneously, adjust the Y-axis position of the engines to align them with the leading edge of the wing geometry. Ensure the transformation is applied symmetrically to both port and starboard wings.

discrepancies.observed: Two engines visible under the wing
Wings are nearly perpendicular to the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Significant rearward sweep of the wings
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: rotate wing primitives backward along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: Engines are positioned close to the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Engines are spaced out along the leading edge of the wing
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: move engine primitives outward away from the fuselage

discrepancies.observed: Flat, rectangular vertical plates at wingtips
discrepancies.reference: Tapered, aerodynamic winglets with curved profiles
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: taper and curve the wingtip primitive geometry
